'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• S-F3.1 — Forecast Quality Orchestration
  Owner: s_and_op_lead
  Trigger: plan.forecast.accuracy.pct < 65.0%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 5.0–12.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · DETECT sustained forecast accuracy deterioration for this SKU/location
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant forecast error driver for this SKU/location
  · ACTIVATE the corresponding execution Action Code for this SKU/location
  ⚠ Trigger only if forecast error is structurally recurring
  ⚠ Do not trigger if service containment actions already mitigate impact

• S-F3.2 — Forecast Bias & Accuracy Correction
  Owner: demand_planning_manager
  Trigger: plan.forecast.bias.pct abs_gt 20.0%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 4.0–10.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify SKUs with persistent forecast bias
  · Correct parameters, overrides, or input data
  · Align planners on bias correction targets
  ⚠ Trigger only if bias direction is consistent across periods
  ⚠ Do not trigger if error is driven by one-off demand shocks

• S-F3.3 — Service Impact Containment
  Owner: supply_planning_manager
  Trigger: plan.forecast.service_impact.pct > 5.0%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: -1.0–-4.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · Identify SKUs/locations with forecast-driven service loss
  · Apply short-term allocation and prioritisation rules
  · Align containment actions with customer service
  ⚠ Trigger only if service impact is forecast-driven
  ⚠ Do not trigger if OTIF loss is transport-driven

• S-F3.4 — Re-Plan Discipline & Stability
  Owner: planning_excellence_lead
  Trigger: plan.replan.count > 6count
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: -20.0–-50.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY cycles or planner scopes with excessive replans
  · ANALYSE root causes of re-planning for the affected cycle or planner scope
  · ENFORCE thresholds, freeze windows, and escalation rules for the affected cycle or planner scope
  ⚠ Trigger only if replans are driven by planning overrides or governance breaches
  ⚠ Do not trigger if replans are caused by external disruptions'
